public_manifest.scope: Repository payload hash/size closure and source-copy recipes only; base source bodies and image payloads are not read by this check.
public_manifest.target_identity_algorithm: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON, sort_keys=true, ensure_ascii=true, separators=comma/colon, no final newline; path-sorted records of path,bytes,mode,sha256.
public_manifest.new_payload_bytes_definition: Unique repository input paths under build-support/public/overlay/
